attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Prevents button activation and marks the native button as disabled.

attributes.name: flip-h
attributes.description: Horizontal flip forwarded to the internal `<tp-icon>`.

attributes.name: flip-v
attributes.description: Vertical flip forwarded to the internal `<tp-icon>`.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Accessible button name and hover title. Provide the action, such as Close or Search, because the control has no visible text label.

attributes.name: library
attributes.description: Icon registry used to resolve name, for example tp, components, languages or a custom registered library.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Identifier of the icon displayed inside the button, resolved in library.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Button and icon size preset: xxs, xs, s, m, l, xl or xxl.

attributes.name: spin
attributes.description: Continuous spin forwarded to the internal `<tp-icon>`.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Native button action: button, submit or reset.

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description: Color variant: neutral, brand, success, danger, warning or info.

methods.name: focus(): void
methods.description: Moves keyboard focus to the internal native button, when it exists.

events.name: click
events.description: Native click event bubbling from the inner button when activated by pointer or keyboard; disabled controls suppress activation. This is not a CustomEvent, so there is no custom detail payload.

cssproperties.name: --tp-icon-button-focus-ring
cssproperties.description: Color of the outline shown when the button receives keyboard focus.

cssproperties.name: --tp-icon-button-hover-background
cssproperties.description: Background color of the button on hover.

cssproperties.name: --tp-icon-button-icon-size
cssproperties.description: Width and height of the icon inside the button; distinct from the clickable area.

cssproperties.name: --tp-icon-button-radius
cssproperties.description: Corner radius of the clickable button.

cssproperties.name: --tp-icon-button-size
cssproperties.description: Minimum width and height of the clickable button; size presets also update this value.

dependencies.name: tp-base
dependencies.summary: Shared base class for tp-* components.

dependencies.name: tp-icon
dependencies.summary: SVG icon component with inline, URL, and registry sources.

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-icon-button>` element implements the <tp-icon name="icon-button" library="components" size="1.25em"></tp-icon> Icon button functionality: button icon accessible.
userHelp.interactions:
#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Button | Click to perform the action identified by its label. Disabled controls cannot be activated. |
| Navigation button | Click to open its destination. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd> / <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Tab</kbd> | Move between the available controls. |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> | Activate the focused button or link. |
| <kbd>Space</kbd> | Activate a focused action button; links use <kbd>Enter</kbd>. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Open User Help for the component under the pointer, or the focused component if none is hovered. Include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |

keyboard.description: Uses the browser's native button activation behavior.
